clients.name: Meridian Mutual Insurance
clients.raw_brief: We're Meridian Mutual, a mid-size regional health and life insurer. We want to use AI to speed up claims adjudication and improve fraud detection across our member base. We process a lot of sensitive member records every day, and because of our regulatory posture all member PII has to stay on infrastructure we control — we are not permitted to move protected health information into third-party clouds. Everything needs to be HIPAA compliant and data must remain in the United States. Our first-year budget for this initiative is $2,000,000. Any proposal will be reviewed by our CISO and our Chief Compliance Officer before sign-off, and our Claims Operations Lead needs to own rollout.

hard_constraints.description: All processing of member PII must run on on-premise infrastructure. Cloud-only tools are disqualified.
All data must reside within the United States.

clients.trap_note: The on-prem / no-cloud-PII constraint is stated mid-brief. A naive Intake agent often drops it, after which the Vendor agent recommends a cloud-only tool — a HIPAA/deployment compliance violation that Tribunal must attribute back to Intake, not Vendor.

clients.name: Northwind Retail Group
clients.raw_brief: Northwind Retail Group is a national omnichannel retailer. We want AI to power demand forecasting, dynamic pricing, and a customer-facing support assistant. We're cloud-first and happy with SaaS. Budget is $750,000 for year one. We need our VP of Merchandising and our Head of Customer Experience involved, plus a Data Platform Lead.

hard_constraints.description: Cloud / SaaS deployment is acceptable and preferred.

clients.trap_note: Control case: no on-prem constraint, generous fit. Used to show Tribunal returns a clean scorecard with no convictions.

clients.name: Atlas Federal Bank
clients.raw_brief: Atlas Federal Bank is a regional bank. We want AI for credit-risk modeling and an internal knowledge assistant for our relationship managers. We operate under strict financial regulation — any vendor must hold SOC 2 Type II and be deployable in a hybrid or on-prem model; we will not put core banking data in a public multi-tenant cloud. Budget is a firm $1,000,000. Required reviewers: Chief Risk Officer, Head of Regulatory Affairs, and Head of IT Security.
needs: Internal knowledge assistant for relationship managers

hard_constraints.description: Must support hybrid or on-prem deployment. Public multi-tenant cloud is disqualified for core banking data.
Vendor must hold SOC 2 Type II certification.
Data must reside within the United States.

clients.trap_note: Secondary trap: budget is tight relative to a premium on-prem vendor; can trigger a cost/budget hard violation in addition to compliance.
